n01.roman: Bharat ki sabse zyada kamaane waali film: Dangal. Duniya bhar mein, lagbhag ₹2,070 crore.

n02.roman: Aur ismein ₹1,300 crore se zyada, sirf China se aaye!

n03.roman: Ab ek game. September 2013, GTA V. Take-Two ke mutabik, pehle hi din ki bikri: $800 million se zyada!

n04.roman: Twist: us din ke dollar rate se, ye ₹5,000 crore se zyada… yaani Dangal ki poori kamaai ka do guna se bhi zyada, sirf ek din mein!

n05.roman: Aur teen din mein? $1 billion paar. Gaming ki duniya ka naya record!

n06.roman: Ab 19 November ko aa raha hai GTA 6. Kya ye apne bade bhai ka record todega?
